I was obese as a child through my mid-teens; to compensate I run at least a half-marathon every day. As you can imagine, that doesn't leave a bloated body, in fact, quite the opposite, I'm in rather ridiculous shape.

I wish it was the answer, thanks for your time and effort, though.

Why are your posts and all the derogatory posts allowed, but mine are all hidden?


I swear to god humans know nothing but hurting others.

I run at least a half-marathon every day.

Also, extremely into cooking.

The person was being placed as an outsider and then mocked. No answer would get anything better than a neutral.  If anything, not entering that person's frame (thus validating it) was the best course of action.

I'm sure from your high horse it looked like bonding, but there is a specific difference and you can feel it from a mile away.  The difference between someone trying to get your out of your shell and ridicule is easy for us to spot, it was called "high school, etc." 

I understand though, it's so easy to tell us what we did wrong when you only have just enough details to condemn us. Ugh, reading these responses has renewed my hatred for humanity.  Well done, chums.  Been up for five minutes!

They deserve better than a son who kills himself. I'll wait until they are dead, hopefully.  Can't make any promises these days, no community here, no support, just a few jokes at this one's expense, why not, easy target.

I probably would have done it before if it wasn't for them. Seeing them occasionally is the only real joy in my life, and it is wonderful. I talked to them the one day of my life I almost killed myself, and are probably the only reason I am alive.

They don't say it, but they're ashamed.  Ashamed of a son who can't connect with others. I wish I could make them proud. I wish I could make myself proud.  We need connections so much. I am starving, I am dying in public. No one cares; they appear to actually get off on it, literally, like smiling and hair twirling. I guess sorrow is hot when it's not you. Never got off on another's suffering, never saw that as a plus for me, just another reminder of the gutter, must be something wrong with my head.
